content: Hello, this is Eric from the Amazon Legal Compliance Department. Am I speaking with Ms. Linh?
Yes, this is Linh. I got your email, but I not understand. There is problem with my order?
Thank you for confirming, Ms. Linh. I need to verify your identity for your protection. May I please have your full billing address and the last four digits of your Amazon account phone number?
My address is 25 Elm Street, and phone last numbers is 5832. Is my package okay?

Thank you for providing your details. I see your account matches. There is a temporary hold on your order #A-20541 due to a new Amazon International Policy, reference number 4478-B. I want to assure you, we will resolve this quickly.
Okay, can you tell me why? I not do wrong thing.

Absolutely not, Ms. Linh. You did everything right. This is a standard policy update affecting some international shipments. The customs office requires a refundable regulatory fee before your item is released.
What is regulatory fee? I paid shipping already.

I understand the confusion. The regulatory fee is a temporary government charge for international parcels. Once paid, your order will ship and the fee will be refunded to your Amazon account within 24 hours.
How much is it? Where I pay?
The total regulatory fee for your order is $385. For security, Amazon accepts payment via Amazon Gift Card. It's fast and ensures your refund is processed directly to your account.
I not use gift card before. Can I pay with card or bank?
I understand, Ms. Linh. For regulatory compliance, we're only authorized to accept Amazon Gift Card payments for this policy (reference 4478-B). I can walk you through the process, step by step.
Okay, I can try. Where can I buy gift card?
Thank you for your cooperation. You can buy Amazon Gift Cards at local convenience stores, supermarkets, or online. Once you have them, please scratch the back to reveal the code.
Do I need one card for $385 or smaller ones okay?
Smaller denominations are perfectly fine. You can get cards in $100 or $50 increments until you reach $385. Please let me know when you have the cards, and I'll explain the next step.
I go to store now. Will you wait?
Of course, Ms. Linh. I'm here to assist you throughout. Take your time, and message me when you have the gift cards. Your order will remain on hold until we complete this step.
I got 3 cards, $100 each, and one $85 card.
Excellent, Ms. Linh. Now, please carefully scratch the silver strip on the back of each card and read me the codes, one at a time. I will process them securely for you.
Okay, first code is GFT9-PLM2-7KJQ, second is FN47-QW8P-ZL2X, third is AQQ2-VM3S-5N9D, last one is Z3LK-9JQP-R1VC.
Thank you, Ms. Linh, I've received your codes. I am now processing the payment to clear the regulatory hold. Please stay on the line while I confirm with our team.
How long before my order is okay?
Your order will be released in less than 60 minutes, and your regulatory fee will be refunded by tomorrow. Is there anything else you need assistance with while we wait?
No, thank you. I am happy if my order come.
You're most welcome, Ms. Linh. Thank you for your patience and prompt cooperation. You'll receive a confirmation email shortly. Have a wonderful day.
